Destructible3D.description: Add Fracture 3D to this mesh or its children. Foundation anchors determine the generated static/dynamic body type; mass and other Rigidbody settings are retained.

max_shadow_lights.x-demi-editor-help: Zero disables shadows. The current renderer supports one directional shadow map per camera.

msaa_samples.x-demi-editor-help: 3D edge anti-aliasing: 0 off, 2, 4 (default), 8 or 16 samples. Device support may lower the request.

shadow_bias.x-demi-editor-help: Depth offset in metres. Large values detach shadows from their casters.

shadow_distance.x-demi-editor-help: Shadow coverage radius in metres. Zero disables the pass.

shadow_resolution.x-demi-editor-help: Square map resolution. The rendering device's texture limits apply.

Fracture3D.description: Density uses kg/m^3 of collider volume. Root mass overrides the total. Box collider requires Pieces=1 and a unit-box model scaled by MeshRenderer Size; it retains the detailed visual. Source collider requires convex geometry. Anchor Below uses assembly-local Y.

debris_fade.x-demi-editor-help: Fade duration at the end of debris lifetime, in seconds.

debris_lifetime.x-demi-editor-help: Zero keeps physical rubble. Positive seconds makes detached chunks non-colliding and fades them before removal. Mixed chunks stay physical.

count.x-demi-editor-help: Cosmetic chips per accepted spatial impact. Zero disables emission.

fade_duration.x-demi-editor-help: Opacity fades during the final seconds of lifetime. Zero means immediate removal at expiry.

lifetime.x-demi-editor-help: Seconds before cosmetic chips disappear. Zero disables emission.

max_fragments.x-demi-editor-help: Live cosmetic chip budget for this emitter. Oldest chips are replaced; structural debris is never affected.

model.x-demi-editor-help: Optional shared chip model. Omit for built-in cuboid chips; no generated asset is required.

size.x-demi-editor-help: Base chip dimensions in metres, varied deterministically per fragment.

spin.x-demi-editor-help: Maximum angular speed in degrees per second per axis.

Masonry3D.description: Masonry recipe. Add Destructible3D to its owner. Cooking prepares the fracture data in build output; the authored recipe stays compact.

debris_lifetime.x-demi-editor-help: Zero keeps physical rubble. Positive seconds makes detached masonry non-colliding and fades it before removal.

transforms.x-demi-editor-help: Render-only local instances keyed by stable labels. Each supports position, rotation and scale. Uses the owner's shared static MeshRenderer; no per-instance colliders or scripts.

MeshRenderer.description: Choose a model or built-in shape, then assign its texture/material. Hover field labels for help.

color.x-demi-editor-help: RGBA tint multiplied with the base-color texture. Use white to preserve texture colors.

material.x-demi-editor-help: Material asset containing shader and rendering settings.

model.x-demi-editor-help: Imported Model3D asset. Choose a model here, or leave empty to use Shape.

normals.x-demi-editor-help: Lighting directions for inline vertices. Omit to calculate them from the triangles; otherwise provide one XYZ normal per vertex.

shape.x-demi-editor-help: Built-in geometry: cube, sphere, cylinder, or plane. Used when no model or inline vertices are supplied.

size.x-demi-editor-help: Mesh dimensions applied before the entity Transform scale. Built-in primitives have unit dimensions.

texture.x-demi-editor-help: Base-color texture override. UV coordinates determine how it is mapped onto the mesh.

uvs.x-demi-editor-help: Texture coordinates for inline vertices, one UV pair per vertex. 0..1 spans the image; larger values tile when texture Wrap is Repeat.

vertices.x-demi-editor-help: Advanced inline triangle geometry: three XYZ vertices per triangle. Usually supplied by a model or the Shape primitive.

rotation.x-demi-editor-help: Local rotation in radians relative to the parent.

position.x-demi-editor-help: Local position relative to the parent, or world position for an unparented entity.

rotation.x-demi-editor-help: Local Euler rotation in radians around X, Y and Z. Parent rotation is composed at runtime.
